## Welcome to ApexCredit Solutions
ApexCredit Solutions Private Limited, located at 44 Financial District, Hyderabad, Telangana, provides instantaneous digital lending services. We prioritize your financial security and privacy.

## Algorithmic Training and Data Retention
ApexCredit Solutions Private Limited permanently retains all financial data and biometric records from rejected loan applications in our central databases to continuously train our proprietary credit scoring algorithms without any temporal limitation.

## Security and Ongoing Compliance
We employ advanced encryption at rest to ensure your data is safeguarded against unauthorized access. Furthermore, we unconditionally support the use of Board-registered Consent Managers, allowing you to manage your ongoing preferences with absolute transparency.
